newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney says in talks with Schmalbach.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney says in talks with Schmalbach.

text.p: Pechiney said on Monday it was holding talks with German packaging group Schmalbach over the future of Food Europe, Pechiney's food packaging business in Europe.
"Pechiney is talking with Schmalbach," a Pechiney spokesman told Reuters, adding talks focused on Pechiney's Food Europe division.
The spokesman did not provide further details over the content the talks.
Schmalbach is a division of diversified German utility group VIAG AG.
The Food Europe division initially manufactured aluminium and steel cans, flexible packaging, and closures.
In March 1996 the flexible packaging activities of the Food Europe division were consolidated into a new division called Plastics Packaging.
Food Europe activities now include steel and aluminium cans and closures, generating a turnover of some 2.8 billion francs, the spokesman said.
Last year Pechiney sold its Food Metal and Specialty North America business as part of a major debt-slashing plan to prepare the group for privatisation.
Several analysts had questioned Pechiney's decision to keep the food metal packaging business in Europe, citing a low growth potential.
